text:
Ava Kim: Heads up - tried to pick up rental in Lisbon and the corpcard pre-auth was declined at the desk. Agent ran the card and it shows a HOLD for 0.00 EUR and then no final charge. I have a photo of the desk receipt but it's basically just 'AUTHORIZATION HOLD' with a merchant code. Help?

Tom Santoro: Oof. Was that the virtual corpcard or the plastic? Sometimes virtual cards don't support pre-auth flows.

Ava Kim: Virtual. I used the card issued for the flight/ground expenses. Manager approved the rental in the travel request. Agent told me I could pay locally and submit for reimbursement but I wanted to check with finance first.

ExpenseBot: Reminder: per policy, pre-auth holds are not reimbursable until a final posted charge appears. If you pay personally, submit an expense with the merchant receipt and manager approval. See https://redwood.internal/expenses/preauth-guidelines :page_with_curl:

Maya Chen (Finance): Thanks for flagging. Can you upload the desk receipt + any rental agreement showing the booking reference? If you end up paying personally, include the foreign card FX fee line. For now we'll mark this as "preauth unresolved" in AP so we don't double-pay if the hold converts.

Ava Kim: Uploaded photos and rental agreement to Concur (link in thread). I paid cash because they wouldn't hold the car otherwise. Amount: 54.20 (includes 8 service fee). Card last4 on the virtual was 9876.

Priya Rao: For approvals: @Ava Kim pls add your manager's note approving the cash pay. Managers: please reply in thread with explicit approval (amount and reason) so AP has an audit trail.

Tom Santoro: Manager approval here: approved for rental due to corpcard pre-auth failure. Approved amount 54.20.

Maya Chen (Finance): Great. We'll process reimbursement once Concur has the uploaded receipts + manager approval. Note: we cannot reimburse FX fee separately if its included in the receipt total, but we will accept a separate FX charge if it's a bank fee (please attach your bank statement showing the fee).

Ava Kim: Quick Q: will finance escalate the virtual card flow with the card vendor? This is the second time it's failed in EU.

Maya Chen (Finance): Yes, I'll open a ticket with PaymentsOps and the card vendor. Please DM me any other incidents. We'll also push a note to TravelOps to recommend plastic cards for EU car rentals.

ExpenseBot: Action items created: AP-TICKET-2026-88 (preauth chase), CONCUR-EXP-2121 (Ava reimbursement), PAYOPS-VCARD-43 (vendor escalation).

Ava Kim: Thanks all, submitting final expense now. :thumbsup:
